meta.name: battle-card-builder
meta.description: Research and draft a competitive battle card from public evidence — every claim labeled and sourced. Use when a rep needs a field-action card, not a research report.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 快速生成带来源标注的竞争分析卡片
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果销售团队需要快速获取可验证的竞争情报。
copy.tagline_en: Quickly draft competitive battle cards with sourced claims.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your sales team needs fast, verifiable competitive intelligence.

howto.what: 输入你的产品和某个竞争对手，Claude 会调查公开资料（定价、评论、发布说明等），并生成一张“对战卡”。卡片上的每条主张都带来源链接和 Fact/Inference/Assumption 标签，按固定模板排版，供销售在30秒内使用。
howto.when: 当你要求制作“battle card”或“对战卡”，并给出你的产品和目标竞争对手时触发。典型场景是销售需要在交涉中快速使用的现场行动卡，而非深度研究报告。

say.text: 做一张 battle card：我们的平台 vs 竞品A，面向中端市场买家。
say.note: Claude 会开始调研并生成卡片。

say.text: 根据这份竞争情报快照，重建对战卡，每个论据都要标来源和类型。
say.note: Claude 会基于快照补查缺口并输出新卡。

say.text: 构建针对竞品B的陷阱问题，答案要来自他们自己的文档。
say.note: Claude 会在卡片里生成可证实的陷阱问题。

howto.what_en: Given your product and a competitor, Claude researches public sources (pricing, reviews, release notes) and produces a battle card. Every claim carries a source URL and a Fact/Inference/Assumption label, laid out in a fixed template for a rep's 30-second read.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for a 'battle card' or '对战卡' and provide your product and a target competitor. Typical when a rep needs a fast field-action card mid-deal, not a full research report.

say_en.text: Build a battle card: our platform vs Competitor A, mid-market buyers.
say_en.note: Claude starts fieldwork and drafts the card.

say_en.text: Rebuild the battle card from this competitive snapshot, labeling every claim.
say_en.note: Claude fills gaps and outputs a fresh card.

say_en.text: Create trap questions for Competitor B with answers from their own docs.
say_en.note: Claude puts verifiable trap questions in the card.
